round1_sofa_sell_and_seen.client: Long Eaton Sofas, Long Eaton (near Nottingham), England. A family firm since 1988: the father John, his wife Aileen and their four sons Chris, Peter, Michael and Tom. Every frame is built in their own wood mill from kiln-dried beech or birch (30-year guarantee on the frame); one upholsterer makes each sofa from the first tack to the last and signs it by hand when it is finished; the sewing machinists have been there since the first year; any size, thousands of fabrics; a seat that needs no plumping; sold straight from the factory from GBP 1,349. Outside its region hardly anybody knows it. THE ORDER: short films for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok that bring people to book a visit to the showroom; a second aim is to be seen widely for nothing.

round2_dental_seen.client: THE CLIENT: CrownWood Dental, Bracknell (England), a local dental practice hardly anybody outside the town knows; its own small TikTok and Instagram account. It makes a crown (a new top for a broken tooth) in ONE visit: a small camera films the tooth instead of a mouthful of paste; in seconds a 3D model of the tooth stands on the screen; a milling machine in the practice carves the crown from a small ceramic block in about five minutes under water; it is bonded on the same day, no temporary crown, no metal, the colour of the patient's own teeth. From GBP 750. Led by Dr Wong, more than 25 years a dentist; over 600 five-star Google reviews, several from people who were afraid of the dentist; open on Saturdays; free parking.

round3_sofa_seen.client: THE CLIENT: Long Eaton Sofas, Long Eaton (near Nottingham), England. A family firm since 1988: the father John, his wife Aileen and their four sons Chris, Peter, Michael and Tom; one of them greets you in the showroom. Every frame is built in their own wood mill from kiln-dried beech or birch, joints glued, screwed and dowelled, 30-year guarantee on the frame. One upholsterer makes each sofa from the first tack to the last and signs it by hand when it is finished; some have worked there for over 30 years, the sewing machinists since the first year. Cloth is marked and cut by hand so that the pattern matches. Any size, thousands of fabrics; a seat cushion (Octo-Core) that needs no plumping; old sofas of their own make are taken back and re-covered. Sold straight from the factory from GBP 1,349. Outside its region hardly anybody knows it; small TikTok and Instagram accounts of its own.
